rows.grounds: compound of lalāṭa, varṇa, rāśi, and stha
compound of sura and arcita in vocative

items.question: What must be done a hundred thousand times in the forehead syllable mass by the god-worshipped practitioner?
items.inference: The verse prescribes a hundred-thousandfold rite situated in the forehead syllable mass for the god-worshipped one.
uncertainties: the exact ritual object of lakṣaṃ is not specified in this verse
items.plain_english: O god-worshipped one, having done a hundred thousand in the forehead syllable mass.
